title: 28 Daily Life - I’m Sorry, I Love You II

content.text: Hello English learners, welcome back to EnglishPod, my name is Marco.
content.trans: 您好英语学习者，欢迎再次来到英语pod，我的名字是马科。

content.text: And today we're bringing you the sequel of I'm Sorry I Love You.
content.trans: 英语：今天我们将为您带来《我爱我貌美》的续集。

content.text: I guess a lot of our listeners enjoyed the first part.
content.trans: 我猜我们的听众对第一部分非常感兴趣。

content.text: And since it was such a romantic dialogue and...
content.trans: 而且，因为是一段浪漫对话……
我们正在准备第二部分。

content.text: So it's even more romantic and I'm sure everyone is going to find some great and useful language in it.
content.trans: 所以它更浪漫，我也很期待大家在其中找到一些有用的语言。

content.text: We've got language that we used to talk about dates.
content.trans: 我们有语言，我们可以谈论日期。

content.text: So useful language for when you're going on a date.
content.trans: 英语：所以用得上当下的语言。

content.text: Well, before we look at this date language, let's listen to the dialogue for the first time.
content.trans: 好的，我们先听听这个日期的语言，然后再看看第一次对话。

content.text: I'm so relieved that your ankle wasn't broken.
content.trans: 我非常感谢你的韧劲，你的脚踝没有受伤。

content.text: I feel just awful about this whole thing.
content.trans: 我对此事感到非常糟糕。

content.text: I want to make it up to you.
Let me take you out to dinner tonight, my treat.
content.trans: 我今天晚上带你出去吃晚饭，我的小菜一碟。

content.text: Thank you for such a lovely evening.
content.trans: 谢谢这样的一个美好的夜晚。

content.text: The food was amazing and I had a great time.
content.trans: 英语：食物很好吃，我玩得非常开心。

content.text: I wish this night would never end.
content.trans: 我希望能这个夜晚永远结束。

content.text: There's something that I have to tell you.
I woke up today thinking that this would be just like any other day.
content.trans: 我今天醒来，心想这和每天一样。

content.text: The twist of fate brought us together.
content.trans: 英语：命运的转折让我们结识了彼此。

content.text: I crashed into your life and you into mine and this may sound crazy, but I'm falling in
content.trans: 英语：我被你的生活和我的生活深深地卷入了。

content.text: It really sounds like they're falling in love.
content.trans: 英语：它听起来像是他们正在坠入爱河。

content.text: Yeah, it's a really romantic thing that's going on right now, but there were some really
content.trans: 是的，它真是一个非常浪漫的事情正在发生，但也有些让人感到有些困惑。
好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: So why don't we take a look at language takeaway?
content.trans: 英语：所以为什么不看看语言小贴士？

content.text: Today, we have three words for language takeaway.
content.trans: 今天，我们有三个词来总结语言学习。

content.text: And the first one is relieved.
content.trans: 英语：And the first one is relieved.

content.text: So we have some great examples on how we use relieved and I'm really sure you can understand
content.trans: 所以，我们有一些很棒的例子，我想你们应该能理解。

content.text: They were relieved to hear that the company would not be making any layoffs.
content.trans: 他们被解雇的消息让公司感到非常欣慰。

content.text: I'm so relieved to hear your voice.
content.trans: 我非常高兴听到你的声音。

content.text: I was worried something happened to you.
I guess relieved is like a happy or relaxed feeling that you get if you avoid something
content.trans: 英语：我猜释怀是当你避免某事时，你会感到轻松或放松的感觉。
正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: I'm so relieved that didn't happen.
content.trans: 我非常高兴没有发生这种情况。

content.text: Now for our second word, pick me up.
So when you ask someone to pick you up, you're saying basically come and get me.
content.trans: 所以当你问某人帮你接车时，你是在说基本上请你来接我。

content.text: Okay, so let's give a couple of examples.
content.trans: 好的，让我们来举几个例子：

content.text: My husband was supposed to pick me up from work yesterday, but he forgot.
content.trans: 我的丈夫昨天应该送我上班，但他忘记送我了。
好的，以下是“所有好”的翻译：

content.text: We'll have a talk with him.
content.trans: 我们将在会议上讨论他。

content.text: Or we could also say, oh, I need to hurry up.
content.trans: 英语：或者我们也可以这么说，嗯，我需要赶紧。

content.text: The taxi will pick me up at seven.
content.trans: 英语：这辆出租车将在七点接我。
正确。以下是该短语在中文中的翻译：

content.text: And our final word in today's language takeaway is...
So, ordinary is a normal word.
content.trans: 所以，普通就是正常的意思。

content.text: So you can have like an ordinary person.
content.trans: 所以你可以像一个普通人一样。
What else is ordinary? 翻译成中文是：什么其他也是普通的？

content.text: An ordinary podcast, which English pot is not.
content.trans: 英语：一个普通的播客，不是英语播客。

content.text: And I guess now we can listen to our dialogue a second time.
content.trans: 现在，我们可以说我们的对话再听一次。

content.text: This time it'll be a little bit slower.
content.trans: 这个时间会稍微慢一点。

content.text: And this will help you to understand the language more clearly.
content.trans: 而且可以帮助你更清楚地理解语言。

content.text: I'm so relieved that your ankle wasn't broken.
content.trans: 我非常高兴你的脚踝没有受伤。

content.text: I feel just awful about this whole thing.
content.trans: 我对此事感到非常糟糕。

content.text: I want to make it up to you.
Let me take you out to dinner tonight.
content.trans: 让我带你去今晚的晚餐吧。

content.text: Thank you for such a lovely evening.
content.trans: 谢谢这样的一个美好的夜晚。

content.text: And I had a great time.
content.trans: 英语：And I had a great time.

content.text: I wish this night would never end.
content.trans: 我希望能永远不要结束这个夜晚。

content.text: There's something I have to tell you.
content.trans: 英语：你有什么事情要告诉我吗？

content.text: I woke up today thinking this would be just like any other ordinary day.
content.trans: 我今天醒来，心想这和任何其他普通的日子都差不多。

content.text: A twist of fate brought us together.
content.trans: 英语：一个转折点让我们相聚。

content.text: I crashed into your life and you into mine.
content.trans: 我将你的生活抛向了你，你则将我的生活抛向了我。

content.text: And this may sound crazy, but I'm falling in love with you, Veronica.
content.trans: 这句话的意思是，她可能觉得有点疯狂，但我觉得你很吸引我，Veronica。

content.text: OK, so we looked at some great vocabulary.
content.trans: 好的，我们看看一些好词汇。

content.text: And now we can look at some great phrases.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: So let's start with Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 英语：所以让我们从流利构建单元开始。

content.text: On Fluency Builder, today we have three great phrases.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: So why don't we just start with the first one?
content.trans: 所以为什么不先从第一台开始呢？

content.text: Yeah, the first one we heard at the beginning of the dialogue.
content.trans: 是的，我们听到的第一个对话开始。
英语：Make it up to you.
英语：Make it up to you.

content.text: OK, so we have some great examples on how we use Make it Up.
content.trans: 好的，所以我们有一些很棒的例子是如何使用Make。
Example one: 一台单反相机。

content.text: I'm sorry I forgot your birthday.
content.trans: 我非常抱歉，忘记了你的生日。

content.text: How can I make it up to you?
content.trans: 英语：如何能让我弥补你的错误？

content.text: I feel terrible for calling your mother fat.
content.trans: 我为此感到非常抱歉，你妈妈长得太胖了。

content.text: I want to make it up to her, so I got her these flowers.
content.trans: 我想要给她点什么，所以我把这些花送给了她。
英语：约翰又忘记了我的生日。

content.text: He's going to have to make it up to me.
We can see from the examples that when you use the phrase,
content.trans: 我们从例子中可以看出，当你使用这个短语时，你应该怎么做。

content.text: You're kind of saying you want to balance something bad you did
content.trans: 英语：你好像在说你要平衡一个你做错的事情。

content.text: Right, so if you call your mother-in-law fat,
content.trans: 正确答案：对，如果你们称呼我的母亲为胖妈，那我就是傻瓜相机了。

content.text: you better buy her at least some flowers or a card or something.
content.trans: 你最好给她买些鲜花或一张卡片。

content.text: So the bad action was calling her fat.
content.trans: 所以那个动作是叫她胖的。

content.text: And the balancing good action was the flowers.
content.trans: 和平衡的好的行动是花朵。

content.text: I don't think flowers will be enough though.

content.trans: 英语：看起来像一场没完没了的婚姻。

content.text: Okay, our second phrase, my treat.
content.trans: 好的，我的好朋友们。我们的第二句话是：你好，我的宝贝。

content.text: So we use this phrase when we want to say,
content.trans: 所以当我们想要表达时，我们会使用这个短语。
是的，所以我可以这么说。

content.text: hey, let's go get some beers.
And our last phrase for fluency builder,
content.trans: 我们的最后一个语境构建指令，中文：

content.text: So Erica, what is a twist of fate?
content.trans: 英语：所以埃里克，什么叫做命运的转折？

content.text: A twist of fate is an unplanned event
content.trans: 一个意外的转折是无计划的事件。

content.text: that has a big impact on your future or your life.
content.trans: 这个傻瓜相机对你的未来或生活有很大的影响。

content.text: Marko, can you give us an example of a twist of fate?
content.trans: 英语：马克，你能给我们一个倒扣的例证吗？
好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: Okay, you're supposed to catch a flight to another country.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: All right, but you're late, so you miss your flight.
content.trans: 英语：一切好，但你超时了，所以你的航班取消了。

content.text: So that's a twist of fate.
content.trans: 所以，这就是命运的转折点。

content.text: So yeah, it's like fate, it's like destiny.
content.trans: 英语：所以啊，就像命运一样，就像注定一样。

content.text: You weren't supposed to be on that flight.
content.trans: 你不是被安排在这次飞行上的。

content.text: Okay, so a twist of fate.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。
好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: On a happier note, let's listen to the dialogue
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: I'm so relieved that your ankle wasn't broken.
content.trans: 我非常高兴你的脚踝没有受伤。

content.text: I feel just awful about this whole thing.
content.trans: 我对此事感到非常糟糕。

content.text: I want to make it up to you.
Let me take you out to dinner tonight, my treat.
content.trans: 我今天晚上带你去吃晚饭，我的小菜一碟。

content.text: Thank you for such a lovely evening.
content.trans: 谢谢这么一个美好的夜晚。

content.text: The food was amazing and I had a great time.
content.trans: 英语：食物非常美味，我玩得非常开心。

content.text: I wish this night would never end.
content.trans: 我希望能这个夜晚永远结束。

content.text: There's something that I have to tell you.
content.trans: 英语：我有件事要告诉你。

content.text: I woke up today thinking that this would be just like any other day.
content.trans: 我今天醒来时，心想这和任何其他一天都差不多。

content.text: The twist of fate brought us together.
content.trans: 英语：命运的转折点让我们相聚。

content.text: I crashed into your life and you into mine.
content.trans: 我将你置于我的生活之中。

content.text: And this may sound crazy, but I'm falling in love with you, Veronica.
content.trans: 这句话的意思是，我可能有点疯狂，但我深深地爱着你，Veronica。
好的，现在我们回到这里。

content.text: Erica, I know you have a story of a twist of fate in your life.
content.trans: 英语：艾瑞克，我知道你有关于命运的曲折故事。
最近，实际上，这发生过了。

content.text: I went to this party and at the party, there was a contest, like sort of a lottery.
content.trans: 我去了这个派对，而且在派对上还有一场抽奖比赛。

content.text: You could buy some tickets and win a prize.
content.trans: 你可以买一些票，赢得一个奖品。

content.text: And the prize was a week-long vacation.
So I went with some friends of mine and they were tired, so they left early and they gave
content.trans: 所以，我带着我和朋友一起去的。他们很累，所以他们早早地离开了，并且给他们留下了辞退信。
我们赢得了连续一周的假期。

content.text: And that was a really lucky twist of fate for me.
content.trans: 这是我一生中最大的幸运。

content.text: I'm sure it wasn't that good of a twist of fate for your friends.
content.trans: 我肯定不是你的朋友们运气不佳。

content.text: Yeah, but they were very generous and let me have the prize anyway.
content.trans: 是的，但他们非常慷慨地让我拥有这个奖品。

content.text: Well, we want to hear your stories of maybe some type of twist of fate that you've had.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，我们想听听你可能有某种类型命运的曲折故事。

content.text: Maybe love stories, maybe tragic stories, any story.
content.trans: 或许爱情故事，或许悲剧故事，任何故事。

content.text: So be sure to leave your questions and comments and your stories at our website, www.englishpod.com.
content.trans: 所以，请务必将您的问题和故事分享给我们，www.englishpod.com。

content.text: And where you can also find us to answer any questions or doubts.
content.trans: 和您能找到我们来回答任何问题或疑虑。

content.text: So I guess until then, it's goodbye.
content.trans: 英语：所以，我猜直到那时，再见。
